# Lunaria - Privacy-First Women's Wellness App

> Flutter app for cycle tracking and women's wellness, designed so sensitive health data stays on the device.

Author: Muhammad Tanveer (Full-Stack AI Automation Engineer)
Contact: mtanveertahir66@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-tanveer-advenno/
Repository: https://github.com/haddindeve/lunaria-womens-wellness-app
Source availability: implementation held in a private repository; access on request.

## Summary
Cycle-tracking apps routinely send intimate health data to third-party servers and advertising SDKs. Users who want the tracking often do not want the data collection that normally comes with it.

A Flutter application built so that sensitive data does not need to leave the device to be useful. Feature-first architecture keeps each domain self-contained, and the design system is specified through screen and component contracts so behaviour stays consistent as the app grows.

## Stack
Framework: Flutter, Language: Dart, Architecture: Feature-first with domain separation, Design: Documented screen and component contracts

## Capabilities
- Cycle and symptom tracking
- Privacy-first data handling
- Feature-first modular architecture
- Documented design system contracts
- Light and dark presentation

## Outcomes
- Sensitive health data kept on-device by design rather than by policy
- Design contracts allow UI changes without redesigning each screen from scratch

## FAQ
Q: What makes it privacy-first?
A: The architecture treats the device as the system of record for sensitive entries, so the app is useful without shipping intimate data to a server.

Q: Why Flutter?
A: One codebase across platforms with full control of rendering, which matters for a design-led health app.

Q: Is it published?
A: The implementation is in a private repository; access can be arranged.

Q: Who is it for?
A: Users who want cycle and wellness tracking without the data collection typical of the category.
